basis: An employee resident in mainland Portugal, not married or married with two earners, with no dependents: table I of the 2026 withholding tables, tax withheld from a month's pay, plus the employee's social security contribution of 11% under article 53 of the Código dos Regimes Contributivos. Each point is the end of a bracket, and the formula is a straight line between them; above 30,000 euros the share withheld at 30,000 is kept

source.title: Despacho n.º 233-A/2026, tabela I: tax withheld from a month's pay in mainland Portugal in 2026, with the employee's 11% social security contribution added
